# Desert Kids Dental

> > Desert Kids Dental is a Las Vegas-based pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Sandra Thompson, offering comprehensive dental services for children including preventive care, restorative treatments, emergency dentistry, and advanced technologies like Solea Laser and Silver Diamine Fluoride.

Desert Kids Dental specializes in pediatric dentistry across multiple Las Vegas locations including Skye Canyon and Centennial Hills. The practice is committed to providing stress-free, child-friendly dental care with board-certified expertise and innovative treatment options for infants through adolescents.

## Core Services

- [Preventive Pediatric Dentist Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/preventive-dentistry): Preventive dentistry services including cleanings, exams, fluoride, and sealants.
- [Pediatric Restorative Dentist Near Me](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services including fillings, crowns, and space maintainers.
- [Las Vegas Emergency Pediatric Dentist](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/dental-emergencies): Emergency pediatric dental care for urgent dental injuries and needs.
- [Pediatric Sedation Dentist Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/sedation-dentistry): Pediatric sedation dentistry with nitrous oxide for anxious children.

## Restorative & Surgical Treatments

- [Las Vegas Pediatric Dental Fillings for Cavities](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dental-fillings): Pediatric dental fillings with composite resin for cavity treatment.
- [Pediatric Dental Crowns Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/stainless-steel-crowns): Pediatric dental crowns including stainless steel and zirconia options.
- [Space Maintenance Providence, Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/space-maintenance): Space maintainer solutions for premature tooth loss in children.
- [Las Vegas Pediatric Root Canal](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/pulpotomies): Pediatric pulpotomy and root canal treatment for tooth decay.
- [Pediatric Tooth Extraction Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/extractions): Stress-free pediatric tooth extraction services by Dr. Sandra Thompson.
- [Las Vegas Frenectomy Dentist](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/frenectomies): Frenectomy and tongue tie removal for infants and children.

## Advanced Technologies & Treatments

- [Solea Laser Dentistry in Providence, Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/solea-laser): Solea Laser technology for pain-free pediatric dental procedures.
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride in Providence, Las Vegas](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/silver-diamine-fluoride): Silver Diamine Fluoride treatment for cavity prevention in children.
- [HealthyStart SDB Treatment for Kids](https://www.desertkidsdental.com/services/healthystart): HealthyStart treatment for sleep disordered breathing in children.
